description: Turn JSON larger than an LLM context window into a JSON Schema of a few hundred tokens with counts and examples; merge schemas and check new documents with fits().
rules: Use compact(document) when a JSON document may be too large to paste into a prompt; it returns whichever of the document and its schema is smaller.
Ask the model for a parser, JSONPath or jq expression from the schema, run it on the full document, and call fits(schema, describe(next)) before reusing it; regenerate when added is not empty.
